failed_acs.text: DockerSandbox.create(config) returns a running container with gVisor runtime (runsc)
failed_acs.reason: create() fails with 'run() got unexpected keyword arguments binds, port_binding'. The code passes binds and port_binding as flat kwargs to containers.create(), but docker-py SDK does not accept these as flat kwargs. binds must be passed as volumes= dict, and port_binding must be passed as ports= dict. This is a regression in the Bug 1 fix — the previous host_config= approach was replaced with flat kwargs that are still invalid.

failed_acs.text: Fallback to hardened plain Docker works if gVisor unavailable
failed_acs.reason: Fallback path (try/except on DockerException when runtime=runsc fails) never executes because the same invalid kwargs (binds, port_binding) cause the create() call to fail before the DockerException path is reached. Verified by direct SDK test: correct API (volumes={...}, ports={...}) creates a container successfully.
